title: scroll-padding - Interactivity - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
INTERACTIVITY scroll-padding Utilities for controlling an element's scroll offset within a snap container. Class Styles scroll-p- scroll-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * ); -scroll-p- scroll-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * -); scroll-p-() scroll-padding: var(); scroll-p-[] scroll-padding: ; scroll-px- scroll-padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * ); -scroll-px- scroll-padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * -); scroll-px-() scroll-padding-inline: var(); scroll-px-[] scroll-padding-inline: ; scroll-py- scroll-padding-block: calc(var(--spacing) * ); -scroll-py- scroll-padding-block: calc(var(--spacing) * -); SHOW MORE EXAMPLES Basic example Use the scroll-pt-, scroll-pr-, scroll-pb-, and scroll-pl- utilities like scroll-pl-4 and scroll-pt-6 to set the scroll offset of an element within a snap container: Scroll in the grid of images to see the expected behavior
Using logical properties Use the scroll-ps- and scroll-pe- utilities to set the scroll-padding-inline-start and scroll-padding-inline-end logical properties, which map to either the left or right side based on the text direction: Scroll in the grid of images to see the expected behavior Left-to-right Right-to-left
Use the scroll-pbs- and scroll-pbe- utilities to set the scroll-padding-block-start and scroll-padding-block-end logical properties, which map to either the top or bottom side based on the writing mode:
Using negative values To use a negative scroll padding value, prefix the class name with a dash to convert it to a negative value:
Using a custom value Use utilities like scroll-pl-[] and scroll-pe-[] to set the scroll padding based on a completely custom value:
For CSS variables, you can also use the scroll-pl-() syntax:
This is just a shorthand for scroll-pl-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a scroll-padding utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:
Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. Customizing your theme The scroll-p-,scroll-px-,scroll-py-,scroll-ps-,scroll-pe-,scroll-pbs-,scroll-pbe-,scroll-pt-,scroll-pr-,scroll-pb-, and scroll-pl- utilities are driven by the --spacing theme variable, which can be customized in your own theme: @theme { --spacing: 1px; } Learn more about customizing the spacing scale in the theme variable documentation. scroll-margin scroll-snap-align
